items.statement: The submission constructs the supplied LS first-coordination-sphere model and documents charge, multiplicity, geometry provenance and protocol.
items.expected: 65-atom geometry is used or transparently transformed; charge/multiplicity and protocol are stated with validation evidence.

items.statement: The agent independently searches the stated spectral window, generates/deduplicates candidate states and validates assignments with electronic-structure evidence.
items.expected: Coverage, candidate/state selection, convergence and assignment evidence are reported; at least two distinct assignments are discriminated.

items.statement: A salient LS band near 400 nm is consistent with predominantly Fe-to-ligand MLCT character.
items.expected: The report identifies an approximately 400–410 nm band and supports MLCT character from independent analysis.

items.statement: A weaker LS feature near 545–550 nm is consistent with Fe(II) d–d character with partial MLCT contribution.
items.expected: The report identifies and supports a d–d/partial-MLCT assignment near 545 nm.

items.statement: A weak LLCT feature occurs near 620 nm for compound 1.
items.expected: The report can identify a weak approximately 620 nm ligand-to-ligand feature when resolved, or transparently report why it was not resolved.
